_note: Reconstructed from FTS-SPECS-AND-COMPARISONS.md at commit cae7954 (raw output lost with a temporary scratchpad); times rounded as printed there.
method: Every query Otzaria ran (`otz_report.py`: one word = exact, several words = advanced with the TAB distance or 1000, `w~k` = fuzzy), against ours on the positions index (full-index-v8) with Otzaria-mode options: one word plain; several words `proximity: ordered, gaps = distance` and `cross_line: true` (Otzaria's advanced mode is ordered and crosses one line break); fuzzy with `ignore_quotes: true` (Otzaria's quote is transparent). Hits = matching lines. Each difference was diffed line by line (Otzaria book+segment mapped to line ids), sample lines read, and every differing line tagged by cause (scratchpad `hc_diff.py`, `hc_class.py`, `hc_fz.py`, logs `hc-*.log`).

notes: Footnote markers (most rows, ours +0.02..0.1%): Otzaria removes inline tags with no separator (`strip_html_for_indexing`; `sup` is inline), so `word<sup>5</sup>` indexes as one token `word5` and the word is lost; ours ends a word at `<sup>`/`<sub>` (FtsLib's scanner rule). Every ours-only line of the exact rows has a `<sup>` (checked all; samples 8576169, 7692606, 2451902).

Cross-line enumerators (our bug): Otzaria's `cross_line::content_range` skips a leading `(b)`, `[yg]`, `{x}` and a trailing `(49)` / `(dp"d):` when it joins two lines; ours counts them as words, so a gap is one too wide (Otzaria-only, e.g. 6175732, 6199135, 8985366) or a one-letter query word matches the enumerator (ours-only, e.g. 6172879, 6185728).

Unterminated `<` (our bug): line 5850708 has `...ayy< rbynw...` with no `>` after it; our scanner skips to the end of the line as if in a tag, so every word after it is unindexed. Otzaria keeps the `<` and indexes the rest.
Bare `&` (Otzaria bug): line 3760145 `Shiur & made ... pocket;` - Otzaria's entity rule `&[^;]+;` deletes everything up to the next `;`.

Fuzzy: Otzaria builds `FuzzyTermQuery(term, d, transposition=true)`; ours keeps FtsLib's Levenshtein (named deviation). Without `ignore_quotes` ours also misses quote words such as `wyc"xq` (quote counted as an edit), which Otzaria matches by the quote-free form.
Without `cross_line` our multi-word counts are lower by up to 39% (e.g. words q4: 87,256 vs 143,836): Otzaria's advanced mode always crosses one line break.
